# Open Cannabis Research Initiative

> Independent, patient-led initiative seeking rigorous, reproducible cannabis research to inform patients and clinicians. PTSD is the flagship proposed research program, not the sole research interest.

Research proposals are not active clinical trials or established evidence of efficacy. Patient observations are hypothesis-generating. No institutional endorsement is implied. Consult original publications for scientific findings and limitations.

## Research and evidence

- [Research agenda](https://opencannabisresearchinitiative.org/research.html)
- [Scientific literature](https://opencannabisresearchinitiative.org/literature.html)
- [Terpene directory](https://opencannabisresearchinitiative.org/terpenes.html)
- [Patient perspective](https://opencannabisresearchinitiative.org/perspective.html)
